title: Vesper and the Choir
author: Zephyrine Vane
blurb: Emrys Thackeray, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
